title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1973-04-02
lineage: SBD -> Rm (7.5 ips/2 Track) -> Dat -> Dat. Transfer Info: Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD (David Gans' Master Discs) -> EAC (Secure) -> SHN. CD -> SHN

ai_review.summary: Crisp Miller‑remastered soundboard capture of the legendary Boston Garden 4/2/73, highlighted by a smoking Here Comes Sunshine and an epic 16‑minute Eyes of the World.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear board mix – the Miller remaster delivers a clean, balanced sound that lets every jam breathe. Musically the show is a spring‑'73 classic: Jerry’s lead work on Here Comes Sunshine and the marathon Eyes of the World are repeatedly called “smoking,” while the second set’s Playing in the Band and Weather Report Suite > Eyes keep the energy soaring. A few reviewers note the obligatory stumble over “You Ain’t Woman Enough,” but overall the performance is rated as a must‑have for any 1973 Dead collection.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 detailed reviews, most giving 4–5 stars and lauding both the sound quality and musical performance; consensus points to an exceptional show with excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Miller remaster praised for crisp, well‑balanced board mix; listeners describe it as clean and ‘crispy.’ Minor file glitches reported by a few, but no major dropouts or distortion.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set 1 mixes tight, concise numbers with a long ‘Playin’ in the Band’; Set 2 builds into expansive jams (HCS, Weather Report Suite > Eyes) and finishes strong with China>Rider. The pacing is praised for space and improvisational depth despite a few standard‑song stretches.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly highlighted for his soaring lead work on Here Comes Sunshine, the marathon Eyes of the World, and overall jam excellence.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned briefly (electric popcorn intro) and generally praised for being in tune with the band; no specific solo comments.
